items.title: Why AI competition from China won't be a risk US tech companies
items.summary:
Host Mark Malek, Siebert Financial's chief investment officer, and his panel of experts weigh in on whether competition from China is a risk to US tech companies.

Today's panel includes Barron's reporter Jacob Sonenshine, The Technology Letter's Tiernan Ray, Epistrophy Capital Research Chief Market Strategist Cory Johnson, and Laffer Tengler Investments CEO and chief investment officer Nancy Tengler.
